legal.contact_line: Questions about this policy: support@amclub.in · Grievances: grievance@amclub.in (acknowledged within 24 hours)
legal.terms_s1_p: AMClub is an online marketplace that connects micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) with independent, verified service providers. AMClub facilitates discovery, ordering and payment; the professional service itself is delivered by the provider in their own name and on their own responsibility.
legal.terms_s2_p: You must provide accurate business information, keep your login (OTP, email, Google) secure, and be at least 18 years old. One account per business. You are responsible for activity under your account.
legal.terms_s3_p: When you buy a service, your payment is collected upfront and held by the platform. It is released to the provider only after you accept the delivery, or automatically 72 hours after delivery if you take no action. Until then, your money does not move to the provider.
legal.terms_s4_p: When you post a requirement, it is shared with matching verified providers in your state, capped at 7 quotes. Phone numbers and email addresses are hidden in pre-payment messages on both sides.
legal.terms_s5_p: Buyers pay the displayed total, which includes GST. AMClub earns a commission from the provider’s side of the transaction; the commission rate is fixed at the time an order is placed.
legal.terms_s6_p: Cancellations and refunds follow our Refund Policy. In short: full refund before work starts, 50% while work is in progress, and dispute resolution after delivery. Orders not accepted by the provider within 24 hours cancel automatically with a full refund.
legal.terms_s7_p: Providers must hold the credentials they claim (verified during onboarding), deliver services lawfully and professionally, and must not solicit off-platform payment before an order is placed.
legal.terms_s8_p: You may not use AMClub for unlawful purposes, misrepresent your identity or business, attempt to bypass contact masking or payment protection, or abuse other users or staff.
legal.terms_s9_p: The platform is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, AMClub’s aggregate liability for any claim is limited to the amount paid through the platform for the order concerned. Professional advice and work products remain the responsibility of the provider.
legal.terms_s10_p: These terms are governed by the laws of India, with courts at Hyderabad, Telangana having jurisdiction. We may update these terms; continued use after an update constitutes acceptance.
legal.privacy_s1_p: Account details (name, phone, email), business details (business name, sector, state, GSTIN/Udyam where you provide them), your orders, requirements and quotes, and basic device/usage data.
legal.privacy_s2_p: To operate your account, match your requirements with providers, process payments and invoices, send transactional notifications, provide support, and keep the marketplace safe. We do not use your data for third-party advertising.
legal.privacy_s3_p: We process your data with your consent, collected when you sign up. You may withdraw consent and request account deletion at any time via support; records we must keep under tax and company law are retained for the statutory period.
legal.privacy_s4_p: If you use voice input, your recording is sent to a speech-recognition service to fill the form and is not stored after processing. Only the text transcript is kept with your requirement.
legal.privacy_s5_p: Payment processing (Razorpay), messaging (SMS/WhatsApp/email vendors), identity verification (KYC services), and speech-to-text — each only what is needed for that function. Providers see the requirement details needed to quote and deliver. We never sell your data.
legal.privacy_s6_p: Your data is stored in India (Mumbai region) with industry-standard encryption in transit and at rest. Bank account numbers are additionally encrypted at the column level.
legal.privacy_s7_p: You may access, correct, export, or delete your data. Deletion requests are completed within 30 days, except records with statutory retention requirements.
legal.privacy_s8_p: Write to our Grievance Officer at grievance@amclub.in or on the company line +91 83411 15455. We acknowledge every grievance within 24 hours and aim to resolve it within 15 days, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, the IT Rules 2021 and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020. The officer’s name, designation and postal address are published on our Grievance page.
legal.privacy_s9_p: We will post any changes to this policy on this page with an updated date above.
legal.refund_s1_p: Your payment is held by the platform and released to the provider only after you accept the delivery (or 72 hours after delivery if you take no action). Refunds below are calculated on the total you paid, including GST.
legal.refund_s3_h: Provider does not accept within 24 hours
legal.refund_s3_p: The order cancels automatically and you receive a 100% refund.
legal.refund_s4_p: Cancelling after acceptance but before work begins refunds 100%.
legal.refund_s5_p: Cancelling while work is underway refunds 50% of what you paid.
legal.refund_s6_p: There is no automatic refund after delivery. You can request revisions (as included in the package) or raise a dispute if the work does not match the agreed scope.
legal.refund_s7_p: Our operations team reviews disputes and can order a full refund, a partial refund, or release payment to the provider. Refunds are returned to your original payment method, typically within 5–7 business days.
legal.refund_s8_h: How to cancel or raise a dispute
legal.refund_s8_p: Use the buttons on your order page, or write to support@amclub.in with your order number.
legal.provider_addendum_s1_p: The buyer’s payment for your order is collected upfront and held by the platform’s payment partner. It is released to you after the buyer confirms the work is complete and the platform approves the release. If the buyer neither confirms nor raises a dispute within 3 days (72 hours) of your delivery, the order auto-completes as described in the Terms of Service and the same release process follows. Refunds and disputes are handled under the Refund & Cancellation Policy.
legal.provider_addendum_s2_p: The platform computes a public reliability score for every provider from verified transaction events: how quickly you respond to requests, on-time delivery, completion confirmations by buyers, and dispute outcomes. These are the factors; the formula itself is not published. Your score accrues from your first order. You can see your own score before it is shown to buyers.
legal.provider_addendum_s3_p: Buyers are rated too, on objective service levels such as confirming delivery on time and payment behaviour, so that reliability is measured on both sides of every order.
legal.provider_addendum_s4_p: When you are matched to a buyer’s request for quotes, you are expected to respond within the response window shown in the request. If you do not, the platform sends a courteous decline to the buyer on your behalf so they are not kept waiting. The first time this happens you will be notified.
legal.provider_addendum_s5_p: Quote and transaction data may be used in anonymised, aggregated form to improve platform services. Photos and voice recordings you submit are stored and may be processed by automated (AI) systems for evidence, verification and service features. Our Privacy Policy governs all personal data.

grievance.title: Grievance redressal
grievance.intro: If something has gone wrong with an order, a quote, a provider or your data and our support team could not resolve it, you can raise a formal grievance with our Grievance Officer.
grievance.commitments: We acknowledge every grievance within {ackHours} hours and aim to resolve it within {resolveDays} days.
grievance.how_body: Email the Grievance Officer, or message the company line on WhatsApp. Include your order number or RFQ id, what happened, and what outcome you are seeking. You will receive an acknowledgement with a reference number.
grievance.whatsapp_prefill: Hello, I want to raise a grievance. Order/RFQ id:
grievance.what_happens: What happens next: we acknowledge within {ackHours} hours, investigate with both parties, and share a resolution within {resolveDays} days. If you are not satisfied, you may pursue the remedies available under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
